purpose: offline diagnostic only; never an identity or association decision
support_definition: projected prior z-buffer sample has valid observed depth within tolerance and lies inside current predicted mask
contradiction_definition: valid observed axial depth is farther than projected prior surface by more than tolerance
occlusion_definition: valid observed axial depth is closer than projected prior surface by more than tolerance
decision_time_contract: all source and target-view data timestamps must be <= decision time; projection direction is independent of causality
